verdicts.defect: No connected-account display: no login name, no Active pill, no granted scopes, no expiry and no authorisation date. readSettings() in extensions.ts returns only { hasToken: boolean, repo: string } and never calls the GitHub API, so none of those values is fetched. grep for 'scopes'/'expiry'/'oauth' in pkg/barn finds nothing relevant.

verdicts.evidence: Clicked 'Remove it' in the settings modal (which raises the warning 'The stored token will be removed when you save.'), then Save. `kubectl -n barn get secret barn-settings -o jsonpath='{.data}'` returned empty, and reopening the modal showed the not-connected state. So the credential really is removed. But the second half of the promise did not hold: I then reopened 'Other ways to publish' on /barn/editor and 'Publish to GitHub' was still listed and still opened its dialog.
verdicts.defect: Two divergences. (1) It is a text link ('Remove it') that arms a clear applied on Save, not a ghost Disconnect button - two clicks and a mode, where the design draws one button. (2) The GitHub publish destination is not withdrawn: the menu item stays, the dialog still opens, and it degrades instead to a warning banner ('There is no GitHub token yet, and pushing needs one. Add one in settings') with the Publish button disabled (button.disabled === true). Arguably better UX than hiding it, but it is not what the design promises.

verdicts.evidence: Confirmed against the live pod: `kubectl -n barn exec deploy/barn-base-extension -- ps aux` shows `claude --dangerously-skip-permissions` (pid 592) as the running process, started by /seed/claude-session.sh, which spells that flag on all three of its invocation lines (pkg/barn/extension-skeleton/pod/claude-session.sh:43,51,52). pod/claude-defaults.mjs additionally writes skipDangerousModePermissionPrompt:true so the confirmation dialog never appears. There is no radio to select. Sending a prompt through the editor terminal produces file writes with no approval step, which is the documented behaviour of that flag.
verdicts.defect: Hardcoded to the opposite. The level is fixed at 'never ask' by the --dangerously-skip-permissions flag in pod/claude-session.sh; 'Ask before every file edit' cannot be selected and cannot be produced by any setting. Making it real means removing the flag (and the skipDangerousModePermissionPrompt default) and giving the terminal a way to surface claude's approval prompts.

Nothing marks this as the selected default because there is no radio group at all; the chip on the assistant panel is a plain <span class="s-chip s-chip--warning">, not clickable (evaluated onclick === null, no chevron).
verdicts.defect: Hardcoded, and hardcoded past this level rather than to it. The design's middle level stops the assistant before commands that touch the cluster; the pod stops it before nothing - claude runs shell commands unattended too, and the pod's ServiceAccount `barn-extension` is bound to cluster-admin (clusterRoleBindingBody in extensions.ts), so 'stops it before anything touching the cluster' is not enforced anywhere.

The design's 'still cannot publish' caveat is also unenforced: the assistant's pod holds cluster-admin, so nothing technically prevents it installing a UIPlugin itself.
